February 11, 2025 - A piggyback mortgage is a junior loan, subordinate to the primary mortgage, which is the senior loan. Junior mortgages will often come with higher interest rates and be restricted to lower loan amounts, and may be subject to additional imitations. A combination loan is when the same lender issues more than one loan for the same purpose (such as buying a home).
